contact.name: Danny Kim
contact.evidence_quote: Milano Freezer was established in 2005 by Danny Kim in partnership with his brother-in-law, Devin Wong. It specialized in making high quality gelato, yogurt, and smoothies. It eventually closed business on October 31, 2013.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Koha Foods began its partnership with Binggrae, a South Korean company known for its gelato-on-a-stick product called MELONA. Melona is famous for its unique texture and fresh fruit taste and has quickly become the best selling ice cream dessert in Korea. It gained popularity in Hawaii in 1995 and is now available at all leading supermarkets and stores.
